method.fetch: Fresh Range-limited GET (first 10,485,760 bytes) with browser User-Agent; WY file also tail-sampled (last 3,000,000 bytes) to rule out sort bias. Medica blocked curl with a Cloudflare JS challenge; fetched via real Chromium (Playwright), full file ~4 MB.
method.parsing: Truncated samples repaired by cutting at the last complete top-level record.
method.nppes: Each key NPI checked against the free NPPES registry API (https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/?number=NPI&version=2.1) on 2026-08-21. Raw responses saved in nppes/.
method.framing_note: All claims are of the form 'the payer's own published machine-readable file shows X' or 'the file disagrees with the public NPPES record'. No claim is made that any provider is fake or that any insurer is lying.

cross_market_baseline.source: 162 provider files sampled across all 108 reachable indexes (scoping/probes/)

metric_assessment.verdict: Defensible with refinements; raw '% of records with >10 addresses' alone is too blunt.
mechanisms_observed: A) Vision-network fan-out: individual ODs attached to hundreds of retail locations across many states (WY/pfpdata).
B) Telehealth-platform NPIs (Headway/Alma/SonderMind PCs) attached to hundreds of in-state street addresses with a single out-of-state phone (Medica MO; behavioral health specifically).
C) Umbrella IPA/PPO NPIs attached to every member clinic (Alliant TN).
D) Plausibly legitimate multi-site practice: teleradiology 79 sites, hospital-system facility records, multi-state-licensed travelers.
recommended_flags: Tier by record type: INDIVIDUAL at >10 simultaneous locations is a strong flag (exclude specialties with known legitimate multi-site patterns: radiology, pathology, anesthesia, EM/hospitalist).
Corroborate with NPPES divergence: directory location count vs NPPES practice-location count/state is the decisive, citable contrast.
Corroborate with phone concentration: one phone across all N addresses (Great Lakes: 1 phone / 352 addresses).
Corroborate with NPPES taxonomy: entity registered as 'Preferred Provider Organization' listed as a care provider.
Separate 'wrong-state share' metric: % of a state file's addresses outside the plan's state (WY vision file: ~99.9% of records have no WY address).
